title: Bettis lab, naval nuclear power and western PA UFO sightings
summary: Dylan Borland tells of Bettis lab, naval nuclear power and western PA UFO sightings, about 1950s-present at Pittsburgh / western Pennsylvania, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Bettis research lab up in Pittsburgh and they were the first people to develop nuclear power for the Navy and that was in the 50s and you get into Kexsburg and all the UFO sightings in the western PA region.

plain: Dylan Borland, a researcher speaking on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, points to the Bettis research lab near Pittsburgh, which he says was the first to develop nuclear power for the US Navy in the 1950s. He links it to the many UFO sightings in western Pennsylvania, including Kecksburg, a town known for a reported UFO event, suggesting the sightings may be drawn to nuclear sites.
